hero.intro: Hey! I'm Juan, a frontend-heavy fullstack developer with over 15 years of commercial experience. I work mainly in JavaScript/Typescript and i'm framework agnostic.
hero.expertise: I'm equally comfortable taking a feature through the backend, the API layer, infrastructure and deployment.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: Frontend-heavy fullstack developer with over 15 years of commercial experience. I work mainly in JavaScript/Typescript und i'm framework agnostic, and I am equally comfortable taking a feature through the backend, the API layer and deployment.

The project I am proudest of was a visually engaging, scalable and fast real-time dashboard for a polling system. Its data visualisation work sparked a lasting interest in chart-building and data representation, and became a turning point in my career.

I have worked in several countries, including Germany, the USA, Australia, Ecuador and Venezuela. Outside of work I am interested in languages and sports: I practise German, enjoy connecting with people from different cultures, and swim.

items.summary: Lead development across the frontend and backend of the company's booking and content platform, including end-to-end test coverage and cloud infrastructure.
Guide the development team from technical direction through to delivery, designing web applications and the REST and GraphQL layers behind them.
Client engagement delivered through Cheers. Built web components and managed frontend state in a large, multi-team Adobe Experience Manager codebase.
Built and maintained frontend applications for a high-traffic e-commerce platform running on a microservices architecture.
Designed frontend solutions and scalable backend services, including Apollo GraphQL APIs for flexible data retrieval.
Delivered end-to-end web applications for a range of client companies, covering UI/UX design, frontend and backend.
Built interactive, responsive mobile applications for several American projects, working to Scrum.
Developed web applications across several stacks, integrating relational and document databases for efficient data handling.
Maintained the organisation's IT infrastructure and built internal web tooling.
